title: deploy and operate the implemented hosted control plane
trigger: a real Stack consumer requires shared remote review after the source-bound consequence flagship passes and supplies an approved authorization, residency, retention, quota, degraded-mode and operational owner contract

title: Git, GitHub, or Graphite transport and review replacement
trigger: the submitted semantic layer proves a transport limitation that cannot be handled by an adapter

title: Nx, Turborepo, TypeScript, and other BlueprintProvider adapters
trigger: one external BlueprintProvider has a concrete user repository, a fidelity contract and adoption evidence that justifies a maintained adapter

title: MCP server, GitHub App, hosted CI, and required-check adapters
trigger: fulfilled for the approved CI, GitHub and hosted adapter slices; reopen only for a concrete new adapter consumer that preserves the same deterministic contract

title: automatic semantic approval and merge
trigger: post-MVP evidence defines policy, identity, authorization, rollback, and audit requirements

title: additional production scenarios beyond the retained RefreshSession flagship
trigger: STACK-CONSEQUENCE-REVIEW passes and a second real repository demonstrates a source, graph, authority or verification shape not covered by SC12

title: DAG stacks, merge-parent selection, and partial-order review
trigger: fulfilled by D38 through D43 and PRODUCT-DAG; retain as historical capability evidence and reopen only for a B18 or B19 trigger

title: Stack-assisted semantic planning and plan-to-work-unit creation
trigger: fulfilled by D31 and PRODUCT-SEMANTIC-0 through PRODUCT-SEMANTIC-VERIFY; retain as an optional historical repository-admission capability under D54 rather than the universal Stack ontology

title: mutual exclusion, reservations, and concurrent-work ownership
trigger: real PR integration evidence proves that optimistic three-way semantic validation cannot safely coordinate a demonstrated workflow without preventive ownership

title: pull-request textual and semantic integration conflicts
trigger: fulfilled by D37 and PRODUCT-COLLAB; C64 reuses the existing exact three-way IntegrationResult rather than reopening a second conflict engine

title: enforceable actor-specific source and capability credentials
trigger: real usage demonstrates that existing accepted WorkUnit source and capability validation at PR time cannot provide a required actor-specific authorization boundary

title: evidence-backed repository revert, rollback planning, and dependent-stack recovery
trigger: fulfilled by D44 and PRODUCT-ROLLBACK as an optional repository-admission capability; generic durable-runtime recovery evidence is separately deferred to B24

title: exact per-revision dependency installation, immutable package caching, and monorepo package selection
trigger: a real repository requires historical dependency semantics that cannot be evaluated with one compatible exact review runtime or selects different workspace packages across the range

title: optional JSON, YAML, and TOML repository configuration authoring formats
trigger: the strict JSON v1 onboarding contract has user acceptance and additional formats can normalize into the same validated repository configuration without creating divergent runtime semantics

title: optional global grfs launcher that delegates to a repository-local engine, plus zero-install pnpm dlx usage
trigger: the repository-pinned install and .git/grfs local-state contract have user acceptance and launcher resolution can fail closed instead of silently changing engine versions

title: standalone and line-level review comments with immutable blob, path and diff-position anchors
trigger: verified PRODUCT-FLOW usage shows that a whole-change request-changes summary cannot guide a concrete correction and supplies immutable blob, path, diff-position, resolution and rebase-porting semantics that never silently move feedback

title: attributed manual merge resolution, octopus joins, multiple heads and larger DAG bounds
trigger: verified PRODUCT-DAG usage finds a compatible repository whose required workflow cannot be represented by one base, one head, at most 64 objects, width eight and binary clean transport joins, and supplies concrete intent, scope, parent-selection, performance and recovery evidence for the smallest expansion

title: merge-queue rebase and squash identity preservation
trigger: verified clean-merge merge-group usage identifies a repository that requires GitHub queue rebase or squash and supplies an independently verifiable mapping from rewritten commits to accepted Plan and WorkUnit identities without provider or message heuristics

title: cross-Plan semantic dependency and coordinated recovery
trigger: real multi-Plan merge-group usage demonstrates that one independently accepted Plan must intentionally depend on another Plan in the same group and supplies an ownership, approval, ordering, invalidation and recovery contract that cannot be represented as graph integration alone

title: portable and hosted DAG and merge-group evidence sync
trigger: repository-local multi-Plan DAG evidence is verified and an explicit redaction profile, authorization, quota, retention and degraded-mode design can extend D36 without uploading source, unredacted Blueprints or making hosted availability part of the required verdict

title: add a second language or source-host resolver adapter
trigger: STACK-CONSEQUENCE-REVIEW passes in the retained TypeScript repository and a second real consumer supplies a language or source-host identity contract that C60 cannot satisfy through the private TypeScript resolver

outcome: Link Stack projections to exact runtime occurrence and retained causal evidence
acceptance: Stack binds exact source/change/evidence coordinates to the consumed causal aggregate without defining occurrence identity or modifying runtime evidence.
Missing, stale, wrong-owner and wrong-revision causal material fails closed and produces Stack-owned linkage evidence for a consumer integration.

outcome: Link Stack projections to exact durable retry, recovery and reconstruction evidence
acceptance: Stack projects exact read-only durable retry, recovery and reconstruction refs without importing durable workflow authority.
Missing, stale, wrong-owner and wrong-revision durable material fails closed and produces Stack-owned linkage evidence for a consumer integration.
non_goals: Durable runtime state or retry authority
Canvas durable inspection or integration completion

outcome: Define the content-addressed Stack-to-Canvas consequence mapping contract
acceptance: Stack publishes a versioned mapping from exact source/change/evidence coordinates to consequence-review projections with immutable producer evidence.
The contract grants Stack no Canvas presentation, layout, admission or integration-completion authority.

title: extract public Stack contracts or a generic resolver registry
trigger: the retained flagship and at least one second real consumer need stable programmatic imports that cannot be served by versioned CLI JSON and private adapters; run a separate design review before adding package exports
